steps: verify repository identity and exact branch/head before mutation
read the focused codebase map, harness registry, skill routing registry, and order contract
classify the requested work as harness, product, governance, runtime proof, or blocked
select the focused workflow from skill-routing.registry.json
run the status reporter with -NoWrite before changing tracked files
preserve unrelated work and use an isolated branch/worktree when another writer exists
stopConditions: product-code mutation required by a harness-only sprint
red dependency owned by another branch
proofCeiling: Read-only task classification and repository readiness only.
